pages.text: Installables are a collection of three different groups: $(li)$(l:mechanics/installables#augments)Augments $(/t) $() $(li)$(l:mechanics/installables#body_parts)Body Parts $(/t) $() $(li)$(l:mechanics/installables#body_segments)Body Segments $(/t) $() $(br2)Installables usually come with abilities, which can be viewed in the $(l:getting_starterd/augmentation_chamber)Augmentation Chamber$().

pages.title: Augments
pages.text: Augments are installed onto specific Body Parts, they are the only installable that creates $(l:mechanics/complexity)Complexity $()and therefore you can only install a limited number of augments. $(br)Installing augments typically provides some kind of $(l:mechanics/ability)Ability$(). $(br2)Augments are also limited by the number on each part. Some augments can only be installed once in total, but some can be installed multiple times on a single part.

pages.title: Body Parts
pages.text: Installed Body Parts are shown on the right of the $(l:getting_starterd/augmentation_chamber)Augmentation Chamber$() screen. $(br2)Each Body Part can only have so much complexity on it, this amount changes based on the type of body part, for example a Cybernetic Brain can support more complexity than an Organic Brain. $(br2)Body Parts can occasionally come with abilities, like the Cybernetic Brain or Eye.

pages.title: Body Segments
pages.text: Body Segments are what Body Parts are installed onto, and Augments also add complexity to the Body Segment they are installed onto. $(br2)Body Segments differ as they are much larger areas, there are body segments encompassing the arms, head, torso and lower body each.
